title: OGS Timeout Risk by Hour
dataSources: Steam activity and achievements (`steam:activity`), Chess.com games (`chesscom:game`), online-go matches (`ogs:game`), and poker home-game hands or settlements (`pokerhome:session`).
app: Gaming and play telemetry from Steam, Chess.com, Online-Go servers, and poker home-game logs sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and export files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ogs:game
| search timeout_flag=*
| bin _time span=1h
| stats avg(timeout_flag) as timeout_rate count as games by _time hour_bucket
| sort - _time
description: Tracks OGS timeout risk over time and breaks it out by hour.
value: Timeout rate by hour is a practical scheduling signal for correspondence or live games.
implementation: Send OGS timeout risk events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1h granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of OGS timeout risk by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how OGS timeout risk changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
